method: Production GPU BRDF plus analytic diffuse/fill versus mean of all 256 pixels in 16x16 Cycles patch; CPU 64 samples; no denoising; linear RGBA32F/32-bit EXR. Not worst-pixel or whole-scene error.

expanded_384.tolerance: Cycles <= 0.005 relative + 0.00002 absolute; GLSL/oracle <= 0.003 relative + 1e-6 absolute

boundary_520.tolerance: Cycles <= 0.005 relative + 0.00002 absolute; GLSL/oracle <= 0.003 relative + 1e-6 absolute
